target.name: American Housing Corporation
target.founder: Bobby Fijan, Riley Meik, Harris Rothaermel, William Davis

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $3M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
American Housing Corporation is a Pre-Seed stage company in Housing & Construction founded by Bobby Fijan, Riley Meik, Harris Rothaermel, and William Davis. The company has raised approximately $2.7M to date. No direct public comparables or private peer transactions were available to inform this valuation.

The analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which is the only applicable approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($2.7M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Pre-Seed to next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $6.75M. This multiplier reflects expected value creation and dilution between funding rounds at this stage.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $8M, with a median point estimate of $7M. Material uncertainties affecting this range include: absence of comparable transaction data to validate stage-specific multiples; lack of visibility into revenue, unit economics, or product-market validation metrics; and the limited methodological toolkit available at Pre-Seed stage where comps and financials are typically sparse. The valuation should be treated as a provisional estimate pending materialization of operational milestones or emergence of comparable market data.
